head: sxy ( FKD; 1493 sexî adj. ar. généreux, euse;   sexî kirin (İlyas p.c))

senses.gloss: to be generous, to dare to spend (normally used with negation –lo)

stems.sensesRaw: to be generous, to dare to spend (normally used with negation –lo)

examples.turoyo: Meqəm ṭurone kətwa, u ʕamo d-əmmat lo masxewa d-qoṭaʕwa. 2019_13_01_Malfono_İshaq

examples.turoyo: U Ḥabib lo masxele d-oxal u malayḏe w maṯ kafino. (İlyas p.c)
examples.translation: Habib did not dare to spend his property and died of hunger.
